# AppSentinels

> > AppSentinels provides AI-powered API security and runtime protection for enterprises, addressing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, shadow APIs, and business logic abuse.

AppSentinels specializes in comprehensive API security solutions with Agentic AI technology, supporting cloud-native architectures, microservices, and DevOps/CI/CD pipelines. The platform offers real-time threat detection, compliance management (GDPR, PCI DSS), and rapid incident response for modern API-first enterprises.

## Key Topics

- API Security
- OWASP Top 10
- Shadow APIs
- Business Logic Abuse
- Agentic AI Security
- REST API Protection
- OAuth Authentication
- Cloud-Native Security
- Microservices Security
- API Posture Management
- Compliance (GDPR, PCI DSS)
- DevOps/CI/CD Integration
- Threat Detection
- API Governance
- Runtime Protection

## API Security Best Practices

- [RESTful API Security Best Practice Guide for Businesses](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/restful-api-security-best-practices): RESTful API security best practices per Verizon Data Breach Report
- [API Authentication Best Practices - Secure Your APIs](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/api-authentication-best-practices): API authentication best practices with OAuth, GDPR & PCI DSS compliance
- [API Security Controls - Essential Protection Strategies](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/api-security-controls): API security controls beyond WAF for business logic & CVE protection
- [REST API Encryption - Protect Your Data & Ensure Compliance](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/rest-api-encryption): REST API encryption with HTTPS/TLS for compliance & data protection
- [REST API Guidelines - Build Reliable APIs with Ease](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/rest-api-guidelines): REST API design guidelines with IAM security & governance best practices

## Threat Detection & Vulnerability Testing

- [API Security Risks - Protect Your Business Effectively](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/api-security-risks): Key API security risks including shadow APIs & business logic abuse
- [What Is an API Attack? Types, Risks & How to Prevent](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/what-is-an-api-attack): API attack types, risks & prevention strategies for application security
- [API Vulnerability Testing - Strengthen Your API Security](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/api-vulnerability-testing): API vulnerability testing for broken auth, injection & data exposure flaws
- [OWASP API Testing Guide - Strengthen Your API Security](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/owasp-api-testing-guide): OWASP API Testing Guide & Top 10 for enterprise security testing
- [What Is an API Inspector? Guide for Business Owners](https://appsentinels.ai/blog/what-is-an-api-inspector): API Inspector guide covering OWASP Top 10, BOLA & mass assignment flaws
